day2_intro.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
day2_intro.text: Oi unc, you reckon you could sell some of these hoons? Boss is tryna find suppliers, ay.

boss_info.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
boss_info.text: Don’t worry ‘bout names… we’re part of the Gumboot Gang. Boss runs things tight, wants these hoons moved fast. Needs someone we can trust, bro.

incentive.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
incentive.text: Cash, bro. Easy money. You sell the hoons, we look after ya. Mean deal, ay?

decline.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
decline.text: Fair enough unc. Offers still on the table tho. I’ll swing by tomorrow, see if you change ya mind.

leave.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
leave.text: Shot bro, I’ll come back tomorrow. Keep it hush hush, ay.

day3_intro.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
day3_intro.text: Oi unc, I see you got the Hoons now? Sweettt. Hey, I gotta get into the club tomorrow but I’m underage… reckon you could sort me some Fake IDs?

accept_fakeids.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
accept_fakeids.text: Choice sweet, bro. Means the boss can trust ya even more. I’ll be back tomorrow to check in.

decline_fakeids.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
decline_fakeids.text: Ahh fair, no stress. Don’t worry, I’ll swing by again.

day4_intro.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
day4_intro.text: Unc, boss was happy with those IDs. Said you’re low-key but solid. Now he’s askin’—could you hold a box of gear for us in the back? Nothin’ big, just stashin’ till we move it.

accept_stash.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
accept_stash.text: Ooshhh, you’re a real one. Boss is gonna rate you hard. Just keep it quiet, ay?

decline_stash.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
decline_stash.text: All good, bro. I’ll tell boss you weren’t keen this time.

day5_intro.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
day5_intro.text: Unc, boss says there’s a big thing comin’. If you’re in, you’ll be looked after proper. We’re talkin’ more cash, more respect. You down or nah?

big_job_accept.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
big_job_accept.text: Shot unc. Boss will come see you himself soon. Mean things ahead.

big_job_decline.speaker: Tane “Big Lad” Moana
big_job_decline.text: Fair enough, bro. Can’t say I didn’t offer. Still mates tho.
